summary: Pixel-perfect native Android redesign aligning the Landing Screen (HomeScreen.kt) and Student Portal (StudentPortalScreen.kt) with the original web app (index.html & student.html). Includes full public sections (Hero, 4-color Stats Grid, About Us, Teachers, Notices with modal dialogs, Gallery, Footer), authentic Student Login Modal with autocomplete & password visibility, rich Student ID card, Profile bio, Fee Ledger with color-coded status, Exam GPA cards, and native Android PDF generation & Share Sheet integration.
